LanguageData.LP_PsionicPower.label: psionic power
LanguageData.LP_PsionicPower.description: Strength multiplier for psion abilities and spells: 0.5 + Intellectual/20, plus Intelligence modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency − 2) × 0.02, and +2% per combined psion (and related) class level above 1 (max +40%). Psionic rolls are also multiplied by it.
